gloss: submitted article; reader contribution; user-generated post

definitions.gloss: submitted article; reader contribution; user-generated post
definitions.explanation: an article, piece of writing, or post submitted by a reader or user for publication

examples.japanese: {投稿記事|とうこうきじ}を{募集|ぼしゅう}しています。
{彼女|かのじょ}の{投稿記事|とうこうきじ}が{雑誌|ざっし}に{掲載|けいさい}された。
examples.english: Her submitted article was published in a magazine.

examples.japanese: ブログの{投稿記事|とうこうきじ}が{話題|わだい}になって{多|おお}くのアクセスを{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: A blog post went viral and attracted a lot of traffic.

notes:
A compound of {投稿|とうこう} (submission, posting) and {記事|きじ} (article). Used for both traditional media submissions and modern online content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投稿記事|とうこうきじ}を{書|か}く: to write a submitted article
- {投稿記事|とうこうきじ}を{募集|ぼしゅう}する: to solicit reader submissions
- {投稿記事|とうこうきじ}を{掲載|けいさい}する: to publish a submitted article
- {投稿記事|とうこうきじ}を{編集|へんしゅう}する: to edit a submitted article

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寄稿|きこう}: contributed writing — more formal, typically from invited or established writers
- {投稿|とうこう}: submission, post — the general act of submitting, not limited to articles
- {読者|どくしゃ}{投稿|とうこう}: reader submission — emphasizes the reader origin

REGISTER:
Neutral. Used in both print media and online contexts.
